name: 1.2 MW row CDU

sources.title: StorageReview: CoolIT unveils CHx2000 CDU with 2 MW capacity

summary: In-row liquid-to-liquid coolant distribution unit of about 1.2 MW, sized for eight to ten 120–140 kW liquid-cooled racks.

capacityW.note: Class rating. The closest catalogued product, Vertiv CoolChip CDU 1350, is rated 1350 kW at a 4 K approach; 1.2 MW leaves margin for a warmer facility supply.

maxFlowLps.note: 1.2 L/min per kW of capacity (CoolIT CHx2000 rating) × 1200 kW = 1440 L/min = 24 L/s.

approachK.note: Vertiv rates its CoolChip CDU 1350 and 2300 at a 4 °C approach temperature difference.

pumpPowerW.note: Hydraulic power 24 L/s × 250 kPa secondary head = 6 kW, divided by a 0.6 wire-to-water efficiency for variable-speed pumps = 10 kW at full flow.

weightKg.note: A 900 × 1243 × 2122 mm steel cabinet (Vertiv CoolChip CDU 1350 envelope) holding a plate heat exchanger, two pumps and about 200 L of coolant; comparable row CDUs list 1,000–2,000 kg.

capexUsd.note: About 180 USD per kW of capacity (judgment range 125–250 USD/kW for 1–2 MW row CDUs in 2025–2026), equipment only.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Judgment: CDU demand outran supply in 2024–2025; vendors quoted roughly 3–7 months depending on volume.
